hotels.title: South Coast Haven: Boutique Mollymook Escape with Daily Breakfast & Rick Stein Dining Upgrades Available
hotels.description: Escape to picturesque Mollymook Beach on the New South Wales' South Coast for a blissful seaside stay at this elegant boutique retreat. Savour the freshest locally sourced seafood at Rick Stein at Bannisters and sample gourmet pizzas, small bites and cocktails at Bannisters Pool Bar, perched perfectly beside the heavenly infinity pool. Between walks along the stunning beachfront, take some time to yourself at Spa by the Sea: a true sanctuary where you can restore your mind, body and soul in a serene setting. Indulge in luxurious treatments using premium products and experience the therapeutic benefits of the private infrared sauna with an included session for two. Dive into the solar-heated swimming pool or stretch out poolside as you soak up glorious views of the surrounding coastal landscape. Beyond the beaches and the nearby Ulladulla Harbour, the South Coast is also known for its wineries and lush rainforest hiking trails that are just waiting to be discovered.
